recentItems.title: One of the Largest Crab Aggregations Ever Recorded 🦀 - BBC
recentItems.description:
200 million crabs moving as one 🦀 

Blue Planet III: Sir David Attenborough returns 25 years after the original series transformed audiences’ understanding of life beneath the waves. He takes us deeper into our oceans than ever before, revealing extraordinary new stories - filmed using cutting-edge technology.
Across six episodes, viewers will journey through five key underwater habitats: Tropical Seas, Open Ocean, Seasonal Seas, Polar Waters, and the Deep, before a final episode looking towards the future of the world's oceans and what can be done to protect them. Made in partnership with The Open University 👉 https://connect.open.ac.uk/ .

#DavidAttenborough #BluePlanet3 #Crabs #Ocean
